title: Fasting and Prayer
english: We can prevail against demons through fasting, but not without prayer; for it is said, 'This kind does not come out except by fasting and prayer.' Prayer is good, but without charity, it cannot ascend to heaven; for the angel said to Cornelius, 'Your prayers and your charities have ascended as a memorial before God.' So charity has borne prayer to heaven.
Charity is wonderful, but without faith, it does not work salvation from sins.
translator_notes: The Greek text may be a fragment, and the translation is literal; no words were added or invented to complete the sentences.

title: On Almsgiving, Faith, Meekness, and Love
english: Almsgiving and faith work together to cleanse sins.
Meekness is a desirable trait, but it cannot produce a royal character without humility.
As Jesus taught, we should learn from him, because he is meek and lowly in heart (Matthew 11:29).
Faith, even in small amounts, has the power to move mountains, but without love, it becomes empty and excessive.
The apostle Paul emphasized this point, saying that even if we have faith that can move mountains, but do not have love, we are nothing (1 Corinthians 13:2).

title: Virtue and Vice
english: May we be deemed worthy of the kingdom of heaven. Do not be, dear one, diligent in faith but lazy in diligence, nor loving scriptures but hating moral character; for one must be rich in good works, in word, in wisdom, in self-control, in righteousness, in courage, in piety, in prudence, and in holiness. Just as vice punishes those who practice it even before hell, so virtue prepares those who work at it to revel even before the kingdom.
translator_notes: The Greek text may be a fragment, as it begins with a sentence that seems to be a conclusion or a wish, rather than a complete thought.
